sources.entry: Devie AI Quota Tracker - Dashboard and macOS menu bar for tracking AI subscription quotas in one place (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor). Supports multi-accounts, notifications, and session-timer start optimization.

summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar app and dashboard that tracks remaining quota across multiple AI subscriptions such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor.
summary.what_it_does: Devie AI Quota Tracker shows quota usage, percentages, and reset dates for several AI coding subscriptions in one place. The README lists Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor as supported providers. A native macOS menu bar item displays the quota of a selected provider, either pinned or sorted automatically by which quota expires first, and a click opens a quick view popover. Multiple accounts per provider are supported, for example work and personal subscriptions. Users can set per-account macOS notifications for low quota, imminent reset, and reset-happened events. A Quota Optimizer option sends a small request right after each reset so the session timer starts immediately. The app also shows Codex reset announcements fetched from the codex-resets.com public status feed. Authentication uses OAuth sign-in per provider rather than reusing existing CLI logins, and tokens are stored locally.
use_cases: track Claude Code and Codex usage limits in one place
get a macOS notification when AI quota is running low
monitor multiple accounts for the same AI provider
see remaining Cursor or GitHub Copilot quota from the menu bar
start session timers early to shorten waits between quota resets
check when Codex quotas have recently reset
how_to_run: Download the DMG from the project's releases (macOS)
Drag Devie AI Quota Tracker to Applications
Launch the app and add an account under Providers
Alternative build from source: install Bun, a stable Rust toolchain, and Tauri macOS prerequisites
git clone the repository and cd into devie-ai-quota-tracker
Run bun install, then bunx tauri build --bundles app
notable: Quota Optimizer auto-starts session timers right after each reset
Multi-account support for the same provider
Tokens stored locally as 0600 files; does not reuse existing CLI logins
11 color themes and translations in 15 languages
Codex reset news from codex-resets.com public feed
caveats: macOS only (menu bar app, DMG download, macOS notifications)
Building from source requires Bun, Rust, and Tauri macOS prerequisites
Each provider requires its own OAuth sign-in
keywords: notify me when quota is low
